about: Renovating an apartment in Hvardiiskyi: quiet Pechersk and classic formats

The complex is in the green part of Pechersk, and many owners want to keep that feeling inside: calm natural shades, wood, textiles, soft light. In a classic interior precise details matter — mouldings, cornices, tall doors — so we specify these elements in the drawings.

For business- and premium-class apartments it is worth planning from the start for good sound insulation between rooms and in bathrooms, separate power lines for kitchen appliances and air conditioners, and a distribution board with spare capacity for future needs.
The management company usually sets renovation hours and the waste removal procedure. We build these rules into the schedule and are responsible for keeping common areas tidy.
For reference: developer — Kyivmiskbud, address — Henerala Almazova St. We do not represent the developer or the management company — we work directly with the apartment owner.

faq: How much does an apartment renovation in Hvardiiskyi cost?

Turnkey renovation starts from $550/m² (works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are extra, per the estimate), a design project from $30/m² (minimum $2,500), furnishing from $250/m². The calculation for a 90 m² apartment is in the budget guide above; we fix the exact amount in the estimate after the inspection.
Do you design classic interiors with mouldings?
Yes. We specify the profiles, moulding layout, cornices and doors in the drawings and check the workmanship at every stage.
Can neighbours live normally while the renovation is under way?
We work to the building's schedule and protect common areas. We do not disturb neighbours outside the permitted hours.
We hand over the apartment with a signed acceptance certificate; all completed works carry a 12-month warranty.
Can I follow the renovation remotely?
Yes. We send photo reports from the site via Telegram, and the price, timeline and payment stages are fixed in the contract.
